cds.title: University of Colorado Denver | Anschutz Medical Campus Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2024). Scorecard/IPEDS id 126562 covers CU Denver | Anschutz Medical Campus together; the undergraduate program and these figures are for the Denver (Auraria) campus, and the map point is the Denver campus, approximate, not the IPEDS location. Only 341 (23%) enrolled students submitted SAT and 31 (2%) ACT, so percentiles describe a small group. International applicants were admitted at about 34% (631 of 1,854); the Common Data Set shows no international first-years in the enrolled residency table although its enrollment table lists 68 nonresident first-time students. A 2025-26 Common Data Set was not found on the OIRE site. No waitlist; no early decision plan. Student-faculty ratio is 17 to 1 (fall 2024).

cost.notes: Costs for 2025-26 from the Common Data Set: out-of-state $36,270, nonresident $39,870, fees $1,163, food and housing $16,598 (the Common Data Set has no in-state tuition figure). The Common Data Set says need-based and non-need-based institutional aid are both available to nonresidents; 129 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received aid (avg $8,675)
